content_review.formal_preview_reconciliation: All 15 own entry pages were compared byte-for-byte with actual preview 006. Fourteen match; the only difference is the formal SOURCE_INDEX, which contains the 286 additional precise references and is the intended root integration delta.
content_review.canonical_delta: Canonical root config differs from the frozen author config only in refs: 41 author refs versus 327 canonical refs, adding 286 precise source entries. Gameplay and player-facing values are unchanged.
content_review.actual_preview: Preview 006 passed with 15 own pages checked and 29 generated files; source/range, association partition, links, GFM, and whitespace checks are included in the pinned passed receipt.
content_review.trigger_and_consumer: Confirmed the source event requires the applicable live Minion target to be staggered when the event is handled, plus the matching source item and held-source gate. Separately, DamageCalculation consumes the target conditional damage_vs_staggered cache only when this hit triggers stagger or count_as_staggered applies. Damage resolves before on_hit, so stacks added by a hit cannot change that same hit; they require a later updated cache.
content_review.tier_and_lifetime: All nine own variants and their actual wrappers were reviewed: Tier I–IV request 1/2/3/4 target layers. Each effective layer contributes +10% to the damage_vs_staggered pool for five seconds. The consumer stat is effectively capped at eight layers; the helper raw admission cap of 31 is separate. At the helper cap, a qualifying zero-add event still refreshes the target effect deadline.
content_review.switch_and_weapon_routes: The actual 21 Mark bindings and special routes match the formal pages: shovel sticky cases, Devil Claw counter, folded shovel/slap, OgrynMaul and Crusher impact explosions, Powermaul sticky skip_on_hit, Slab special block, Thunderhammer activation versus charged hit, and actual push Attack routes are distinguished. A weapon switch prevents new applications from the unequipped source but does not remove an existing target effect before expiry; later consumption remains subject to stagger/cache conditions.
content_review.examples: Both named examples were checked against their selected action/profile and normalized damage-pool stages: Thunderhammer Mk II action_left_heavy / thunderhammer_heavy at N=4 to N=8 gives 140 to 180 from D0=100; Ogryn shovel Mk XIX action_light_1 / ogryn_shovel_light_linesman at N=2 to N=4 gives 120 to 140. These are conditional damage-stage calculations, not final HP predictions.
content_review.raw_and_translation: The paired English and Traditional Chinese RAW templates, tier formatter reconstruction I–IV, and five-column rule comparisons were reviewed. The formal comparison preserves exact source wording, identifies omitted runtime conditions as not covered by the text, and limits explicit discrepancy claims to supported conflicts.
